instruction: Cinematic video still, medium shot. Inside an indoor boxing gym ring, the woman in the black and orange athletic suit (R1) stands on the left facing right, holding a red focus mitt steady. The woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands on the right facing left, her back partially to the camera, with her left arm fully extended as her black glove connects with the mitt. Cool overhead lighting casts soft shadows across the ring, with several black hanging punching bags visible in the background.
